job.purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed qkd_sbuf-a-0feeb971e-tc-hm10-cl (ot_qkvd_sbuf, RTL 0feeb971e): same RTL, outline 237.6x151.2, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:el1011-q-kvd

benches.name: sbuf_d48
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012  -s tb_qkvd_buf_tile -P tb_qkvd_buf_tile.D=48 -P tb_qkvd_buf_tile.N=200000 -o {RUN}/bench/sbuf_d48 rtl/test/qwen_kv_die/tb_qkvd_buf_tile.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_buf_tiles.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_fifo_sl.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2.v && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/sbuf_d48 | tee {RUN}/bench/sbuf_d48.log && grep -q "^PASS" {RUN}/bench/sbuf_d48.log
